personality_one_liner: A sharp, minimal, and highly utilitarian native iOS experience focused on raw functionality without visual noise.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native generous padding. Avoid tight clustering.

do's: Use glass on the bottom sticky container for the Export button
Use glass on the sticky top header (search and select-all row)
dont's: Do not use glass on list rows or cards

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Allow users to view all contacts, search, multi-select, and export them as a VCF file.

states.empty: Full screen abstract background with gradient scrim, a lock or folder icon, a short text ('No contacts found' or 'Permission Denied'), and an 'Open Settings' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Root is a View with surface background. Top: Sticky Header containing Search Bar (surfaceSecondary background, md radius) and below it a row with 'N Selected' (lg text) and 'Select All' toggle. Middle: FlatList of contacts. Each row: min height 60pt, row direction. Left: Avatar (40x40 circle, brandTertiary bg, onBrandTertiary initials). Center: Column with Name (lg, 500, onSurface) and Phone (base, 400, onSurfaceSecondary). Right: Checkbox (Ionicons checkmark-circle filled in brandPrimary if selected, ellipse-outline in onSurfaceTertiary if not). Bottom: Absolute positioned container (bottom safe area + md padding) using glassmorphism (expo-blur), holding a pill-shaped brandPrimary Export button. Add 100pt paddingBottom to FlatList so last items aren't hidden by the floating CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. No indigos or blues.
Use Moss Green (#4F6B56) for primary actions.
Contacts List: Build a highly performant FlatList. Each row must be at least 60pt tall.
Avatars: Since real logos aren't applicable here, build initials-based avatars inside a circular View with brandTertiary background and onBrandTertiary text (Tier 3 fallback as per rules).

Empty/Permission State: Since 'An icon alone is not enough', use the provided empty_state_bg. Apply the STRICT text-on-image scrim pattern: Layer 0 = image, Layer 1 = vertical expo-linear-gradient from transparent (0%) to ~20% surfaceInverse (50%) to 70%+ surfaceInverse (100%), Layer 2 = text and CTA placed in the bottom 40% using onSurfaceInverse color.

Export CTA: Must be sticky at the bottom using expo-blur container, overlaid on top of the FlatList. The FlatList needs contentContainerStyle paddingBottom equal to the CTA height so the last contacts are reachable.
Haptics: Provide haptic feedback on selecting/deselecting a contact, select all, and successful export.
Export Logic: Use expo-contacts to fetch locally, generate the VCF string locally (do not send to servers), and share via expo-sharing.

Ensure 'Select All' works intuitively with search filtering (e.g., selecting all only applies to currently filtered results if a search is active, or globally depending on standard UX, default to global for simplicity unless filtered).
